title: Design and Analysis of Accelerometer MEMS for Range of Motion Applications
content: This report introduces a differential capacitance accelerometer principle and the implementation of a reference design, modification of design to meet the design specifications defined for the Range of Motion (ROM) analysis application. The modified design is analysed for its structural and operational stability and evaluated against the design specification and standard design criteria. With the proposed model the sensitivity of 4.62 fF/g was achieved and around 15 mV/g of sense voltage.
